app_fee.value: Non-refundable graduate application fee is $60 USD for in-person graduate programs (international applicants unable to pay online or by check/money order may pay via wire transfer through Student Accounts).
app_fee.quote: After you submit the application, you will see instructions for paying the $60 non‑refundable application fee on the status page of your application portal. International students may pay the application fee via wire transfer if they are unable to pay online or by check/money order.

fee_waiver.value: A fee waiver is listed as a payment option 'if eligible' (selected programs offer fee waivers for attending virtual information sessions, but no general international fee waiver is published).
fee_waiver.quote: A $60 nonrefundable application fee is required for in-person programs. | Payment options: | Credit card (after application submission) | Check or money order | Fee waiver (if eligible)

gre_general.value: GRE/GMAT is not required for many Montclair graduate programs, and individual programs set whether GRE scores are required or optional (when required by a doctoral program, GRE waivers are not offered).

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score is 4.5 on the New Version or 83 on the Old Version (school code 2520).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL IBT (Test of English as a Foreign Language, Internet Based Test) | Minimum Score: | 83 (Old Version) | 4.5 (New Version) | School Code: 2520

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS score is 6.5 (Duolingo 105, PTE-A 53, and iTEP 4.5 are also accepted).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (International English Language Testing System) | Minimum Score: 6.5

english_waiver.value: India is not on Montclair's English Proficiency Test Exemptions country list, and proof of Medium of Instruction (MOI) in English alone is not sufficient; Indian applicants must submit test scores unless they completed at least one academic year (2 semesters or 3 quarters) of full-time non-ESL study in the U.S. or an exempt country.
english_waiver.quote: Proof of medium of instruction (MOI) in English is NOT sufficient, however the English Language Proficiency requirement can be waived if you meet one of the criteria listed below: | Students who are citizens of the United States. | Students who are citizens of one of the countries exempted from the English Language Proficiency requirement.

notes: Located in Montclair, NJ (Carnegie R2). Non-U.S. degree holders applying to doctoral programs must submit an official course-by-course NACES credential evaluation (most doctoral applicants are not eligible for Montclair's limited free TEC evaluation). Admitted F-1/J-1 graduate students must pay a $1,000 enrollment deposit (credited to first-semester fees). Only one Ph.D. falls within the 18 Atlas STEM fields: Environmental Science and Management (other Montclair Ph.D.s are Clinical Psychology, Industrial and Organizational Psychology, Counseling, Family Science and Human Development, Mathematics Education, and Teacher Education and Teacher Development).
